jobs_results.title: Social Media & Digital Marketing Executive
jobs_results.description:
About the job:

We are looking for a smart, creative, highly skilled, and digitally savvy Social Media & Digital Marketing Executive to manage and strengthen our organization's online presence. The candidate should have excellent English communication skills and hands-on expertise in social media management, content creation, graphic design, AI tools, digital marketing, and website management.



Key Responsibilities



A. Social Media Management

1. Manage Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and other social media platforms.

2. Develop and execute social media strategies and content calendars.

3. Create engaging posts, reels, videos, stories, campaigns, and captions.

4. Monitor engagement, audience interactions, trends, and social media performance.

5. Analyze social media insights and prepare performance reports.

6. Research trends, hashtags, competitors, and new digital opportunities.



B. Content & Graphic Design

1. Create professional social media creatives, banners, posters, presentations, and promotional materials.

2. Design content using Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or equivalent tools.

3. Create and edit short-form videos, reels, and promotional content.

4. Maintain consistent branding across all digital platforms.



C. AI & Technology

1. Use AI tools for content creation, research, brainstorming, design, video creation, and productivity.

2. Identify new AI tools that can improve marketing and content workflows.

3. Review and refine AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, originality, and brand quality.



D. Website Management

1. Manage and update website content using WordPress or other CMS platforms.

2. Upload blogs, images, announcements, events, and other digital content.

3. Support basic SEO, landing pages, and website content optimization.

4. Coordinate with technical teams for website improvements and troubleshooting.



E. Digital Marketing

1. Support SEO, email marketing, online campaigns, and lead-generation activities.

2. Assist with webinars, events, and digital promotions.

3. Conduct competitor and market research.

4. Track campaign performance and recommend improvements.
